name: Havenford
notice: Welcome to Havenford. Guild Street is north of the square.
news: Training halls stand north of Havenford Square.
Roads north of the city remain safe through the frontier post.
Beyond the warning sign, beasts wander in the meadow.
The northwest Aether Observatory welcomes apprentice magic-users.
The southwest keep offers locks, traps and ascending thief challenges.

rooms.name: Provisioner
rooms.greeting: Keeper: Basic supplies for careful travellers.

rooms.name: Smithy
rooms.greeting: Smith: I can repair your worn equipment.

rooms.name: River Inn
rooms.greeting: Innkeeper: The city is safe; danger lies up the north road. Take the square's east exit, then go north through the North Gate.

rooms.name: Notice Kiosk
rooms.greeting: Newskeeper: Read the road warnings before leaving town.

rooms.name: Exchange
rooms.greeting: Broker: Bring me your unwanted finds.

rooms.name: Ground-floor entry
rooms.greeting: A plaque reads: Practice locks first; then try the upper floors.
